methodology.entityRecall: Micro recall over positive expected typed IDs; precision per query is also reported.
methodology.pathAccuracy: Exact ordered typed nodes AND relation labels matched / expected paths (path coverage, not returned-path precision).
methodology.multiHopSuccess: All expected entities AND paths present on positive 2+ hop queries; negative abstention scored separately.
methodology.baseline: Unchanged Hybrid top5 + deterministic entity/path extraction from retrieved chunk metadata; no runtime TestCase/Execution lookup. No LLM.
methodology.graph: Same Hybrid top5 + fixed anchored Graph traversal over persisted runtime data. Retrieval ranks/scores unchanged.
limitations: 20 curated queries share a small synthetic domain; not independent broad-domain samples.
Graph has structured runtime relations unavailable in the text corpus; measures added relation access, not intrinsic search superiority.
No new LLM calls or answer-quality judging.
One cold request may affect latency; three sequential repetitions per query.
